nom: No7 Future Renew Damage Reversal Serum

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum feels moisturizing and smooths texture, with one describing it as achieving a 'glass skin' look and another finding it eased persistent dullness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and good tolerance, though a couple describe breakouts or fluid-filled blisters when first using it.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination/sensitive skin reports the product worked well and glided on smoothly.
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum absorbs without leaving shine or greasiness, though one advises against it for oily skin overall.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers frequently report visible softening of lines, firmer texture, and brighter tone, describing it as suited to older or 'mature' skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer or less noticeable fine lines, firmer skin, and improved tone within one to four weeks; a few report no change in lines, firmness, or puffiness after a month of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe increased hydration, softness, and a non-greasy moisturized feel; one notes the serum relieves dryness immediately on application.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports reduced redness around pores, while another with rosacea reports it was aggravated by the product.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation or allergic reaction, while others report breakouts or small fluid-filled blisters shortly after starting use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report lightening of dark spots, sun spots, or hyperpigmentation after a few weeks; one reviewer notes it did not help with age spots.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report fading of acne scars, but multiple others report new or worsened acne and breakouts after use, including one describing severe all-over acne with no improvement.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum does not add shine or greasiness and leaves a matte, comfortable finish.

aspects.libelle: Slow or unclear results after a month

extraits.titre: Caused horrible acne and no skin improvement
extraits.texte: I bought the whole line. I have never in my life had such a severe acne problem as I did from these products! I almost never have blemishes and when I do its only in a couple places but these products gave me acne all over! I noticed no improvement to my skin at all. Complete waste of money.

extraits.titre: Thought it would smooth out my skin more
extraits.texte: I had super high hopes when reading the reviews, but after months of using this, it's ...ok I guess? I didn't notice any huge changes. My rosacea was aggravated and my skin didn't really smooth out in tone or texture. It was a nice moisturizer and definitely a good budget optioned compared to other brands.

This product, No 7 Future Renew Damage Reversal Serum is made generously for glorious mature women! I am an Arizona native, so I was really excited to try this for my dull, dry, skin. After washing and toning, I use No7 eye serum and No 7 Future Renew Damage Reversal Serum. I am one that typically uses more natural remedies for my skin. This made such a huge difference, I'm sold.

I have dry skin but this product truly has made my skin feel so smooth. It really gives the desired glass skin I've been looking for. Give it a try if you have dry skin. I would not recommend for oily skin.

I use this serum in the morning and at night on my face and neck. I really like how it makes my skin look and feel. It is not a heavy, thick serum and goes on smoothly and doesn't leave my feeling sticky. I tend to be oily and this doesn't make me look shiny at all. I feel like my skin looks more even, firm and not dry or oily.

I have combination sensitive skin, however, this product worked well with my skin type, and I love the fact the product is fragrance free, cruelty free, and glides on very smooth. It is a great product for the money, and I have seen some benefit to using the product.

Want to feel pampered? The serum gently absorbs into your skin immediately without a heavy or greasy feeling. After weeks of using the serum, I've noticed fewer fine lines, and my skin is softer than ever. My skin tends to be sensitive to many face products, leading to breakouts, but not once did I have any issues while using it. Everything about this product was well thought out, from the formulation down to the packaging. I was given a free sample in exchange for my honest opinion.
